# FLM Ceramics (concept by Kerblabs, not affiliated)

> Handmade tile and handmade pottery studio and showroom, Petaluma, California. Facts from flmceramics.com.

- Address: 301 2nd Street, Petaluma, CA 94952
- Phone: 415.272.9997
- Email: flmceramics@gmail.com
- Showroom hours (pottery and tile storefront only): Monday 10-4, Thursday 10-5, Friday 10-5. Saturday listing on their site is garbled; confirm by phone.
- Full studio tour: by appointment.
- Makes: handmade tile, handmade pottery including dinnerware. Also workshops and events, and a printed tile catalog with samples.

## Actions
- Request tile catalog: submit a mailing address via the form on flmceramics.com
- Arrange a studio tour: call 415.272.9997 or email flmceramics@gmail.com

## FAQ
- Where? 301 2nd Street, Petaluma, CA 94952.
- Studio tour? By appointment.
